stories.title: Sopravvive a due iniezioni letali, Christa Pike si risveglia in ospedale

en.title: Survives two lethal injections, Christa Pike wakes up in hospital
en.summary: A woman sentenced to death in Tennessee in 1996 regained consciousness after receiving two doses of pentobarbital. Her legal team is requesting a commutation of her sentence amid disputes over responsibility and potential further execution.

stories.title: Mar Nero, Putin provoca l’Europa: colpite navi al largo della Bulgaria

en.title: Black Sea, Putin provokes Europe: ships hit off Bulgaria
en.summary: Drone attacks on three cargo vessels began Monday off Bulgaria's coast, with 15 crew members reported missing. One merchant ship was heading to the port of Ravenna.

stories.title: Christa Pike ha ripreso conoscenza e parla

en.title: Christa Pike has regained consciousness and is speaking
en.summary: A death row inmate in the United States has regained consciousness and is able to speak after surviving execution. Her lawyers describe the case as unprecedented.

stories.title: Christa Pike, sopravvissuta a due iniezioni letali negli Usa, è cosciente e parla

en.title: Christa Pike, survived two lethal injections in the US, is conscious and speaking
en.summary: A death-sentenced woman has regained consciousness and regained the ability to speak after surviving execution. Her legal team characterizes the situation as without precedent.

stories.title: Dalla Francia agli Usa, Trump cavalca le proteste: immigrazione e islam armi per le Midterm

en.title: From France to the USA, Trump rides protests: immigration and Islam weapons for the Midterm
en.summary: The U.S. president is leveraging protests across France and other locations, utilizing immigration and Islam-related issues as campaign tools ahead of midterm elections while engaging in hybrid conflict with the European Union.

stories.title: Auto sulla folla a Modena, El Koudri tenta il suicidio in carcere

en.title: Car into crowd in Modena, El Koudri attempts suicide in prison
en.summary: The suspect in a vehicle-into-crowd incident in Modena attempted suicide in jail by ingesting large quantities of medications. Investigators are examining how the detainee obtained and accumulated the drugs.

stories.title: Attentato di Modena, El Koudri tenta il suicidio in carcere

en.title: Modena attack: El Koudri attempts suicide in prison
en.summary: A suspect in a Modena attack ingested medication while in custody. He is reported to be out of immediate danger.

stories.title: Arrestato ex capo 007 tedeschi: ombra di Putin. A Mosca pioggia di droni. Mar Nero, colpite 2 navi

en.title: Former German intelligence chief arrested: Putin shadow. Moscow drone rain. Black Sea, 2 ships hit
en.summary: The arrest of a former German intelligence director has renewed suspicion regarding his connections to Russia and China. Separately, Moscow faced drone attacks and two vessels were struck in the Black Sea.

stories.title: Tennessee, Christa Pike è cosciente e parla dopo l’esecuzione fallita con due iniezioni “letali”

en.title: Tennessee, Christa Pike is conscious and speaking after failed execution with two "lethal" injections
en.summary: An inmate survived two doses of pentobarbital and remains hospitalized. Her attorneys indicate her prognosis remains uncertain and anticipate an extended recovery period.

stories.title: Trump, 'Islam e immigrazione responsabili di quanto accade in Francia'

en.title: Trump, 'Islam and immigration responsible for what is happening in France'
en.summary: A political figure made statements attributing developments in France to issues related to Islam and immigration rather than education policy.

stories.title: Garlasco, Sempio: “Non vivo più, la macchia dell’assassino non te la levi. Stasi? Condanna giusta”

en.title: Garlasco, Sempio: "I no longer live, the stain of murderer never leaves you. Stasi? Just conviction"
en.summary: A suspect in the Chiara Poggi murder case appeared on television discussing his situation, addressing evidence related to a bloodstained footprint and denying interest in the victim.

stories.title: Francia, studenti in piazza: fermate 488 persone, licei chiusi, scontri a Parigi. Macron convoca il governo, Trump accusa l’Islam

en.title: France, students in streets: 488 arrested, schools closed, clashes in Paris. Macron convenes government, Trump accuses Islam
en.summary: Police clashed with demonstrators across multiple French cities, resulting in arrests and school closures, while political figures offered differing interpretations of the violence.

stories.title: Dal 20 al 22 ottobre a NetZero confronto sulla elettrificazione dell’economia

en.title: October 20-22 at NetZero discussion on economy electrification
en.summary: NetZero Milan, a Fiera Milano event, hosts its second edition addressing energy costs, industrial competitiveness, and ecological transition challenges related to economic electrification.

stories.title: Poggipolini, con la saldatura hi tech nuove commesse da Leonardo

en.title: Poggipolini, with hi-tech welding new orders from Leonardo
en.summary: Poggipolini has secured new contracts from Leonardo using advanced welding technology demonstrated at its Aviotec facility in Marnate.

stories.title: Data center, al via progetto per una rete di 13 impianti

en.title: Data center, project launches for a network of 13 facilities
en.summary: Core Stack, a company from the Lazzari group specializing in digital infrastructure, has partnered with Green Arrow Capital to develop a network of 13 data centers. The project was presented in Rome.

stories.title: Elettrodomestici, per gli italiani la durata conta più del prezzo

en.title: Appliances, durability matters more than price for Italians
en.summary: Italian consumers prioritize product durability over price when purchasing appliances, with 58% citing longevity as a primary purchasing criterion ahead of energy consumption.

stories.title: Uranio, Mike Pompeo nominato presidente di Reveille Resources

en.title: Uranium, Mike Pompeo appointed president of Reveille Resources
en.summary: Mike Pompeo has been appointed president of Reveille Resources, an exploration and development company focused on historic uranium deposits in Italy, including sites at Novazza and Val Vedello.
